notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hey! in an attempt to get achievements working, I reworked the code for achievements, updated the event system a bit and updated how input is handled!

overall the changes are:
[list]
[*]intro "splash screens" are now skippable via pressing the up/W key
[*]minor tweaks/changes to input code
[*]updated how achievements are handled/checked (hoping this fixes achievement issues for those who had them)
[/list]

P.S.
As for things to come, I started working with someone on a Brazilian Portuguese translation! look forward to it!
